stemMd: Which EU institution consists of the member states' heads of state or government and sets broad political priorities?

options.label: D
options.textMd: The Council of the European Union

explanationMd: The European Council provides overall political direction through meetings of national leaders. It is distinct from the ministerial Council of the EU. Similar names do not imply identical membership or functions.

distractorRationale.a: Commissioners do not sit as national heads of government.
